nodes.title: Application Shell
nodes.summary: Owns responsive navigation and the desktop/mobile page frame.

nodes.title: Dashboard
nodes.summary: Projects today's information without owning business records.

nodes.title: Study Timer

nodes.title: Project Planning
nodes.summary: Navigator and Workspace views for Project → Workstream → Section → Task planning.

nodes.title: Daily Routine
nodes.summary: Weekday operating templates copied into historically stable daily instances.

nodes.title: Habits
nodes.summary: Recurring behaviors with daily evidence and a contribution-style consistency view.

nodes.title: Calendar
nodes.summary: Full-screen ten-week planning for Events, Workstream spans, and Task spans or deadlines.

nodes.title: Caffeine intake
nodes.summary: Intake records projected as a scrollable time-varying estimated body load.

nodes.title: Quotes
nodes.summary: Categorized quotation CRUD with a daily Dashboard projection.

nodes.title: Settings
nodes.summary: Device-local preferences and the timetable import entry point.

nodes.title: Stats

nodes.title: Dosage

nodes.title: Neon Backend
nodes.summary: Groups the Auth, Data API, and RLS-backed Postgres boundary.

nodes.title: Neon Auth
nodes.summary: Owns real user sessions and provides authenticated JWTs.

nodes.title: Neon Data API
nodes.summary: Carries authenticated PostgREST-compatible queries to Postgres.

nodes.title: study_sessions
nodes.summary: Durable timed and manually added study intervals protected by owner-only RLS.

nodes.title: subjects
nodes.summary: Global user-managed academic subjects optionally referenced by Workstreams and Study events.

nodes.title: projects
nodes.summary: Long-running outcomes with explicit status, dates, D-Day, and sibling position.

nodes.title: workstreams
nodes.summary: Optional Project subdivisions with an optional reusable Subject reference.

nodes.title: sections
nodes.summary: Optional-date Workstream groups with stable sibling order and archival.

nodes.title: tasks
nodes.summary: Planning leaves with required Project and optional legacy Section assignment.

nodes.title: routine templates & instances
nodes.summary: Weekday definitions and copied daily completion records protected by RLS.

nodes.title: habit definitions & daily records
nodes.summary: Binary/counter definitions and one non-negative value per date.

nodes.title: events
nodes.summary: Timed and all-day calendar records with optional Study subjects.

nodes.title: caffeine intakes & presets
nodes.summary: Dose history plus reusable owner-defined drink and tablet presets.

nodes.title: quote categories & quotes
nodes.summary: Owner-managed categorized quotations and Dashboard eligibility.

nodes.title: timetables, courses & meetings
nodes.summary: Imported semester identity, Subject-linked courses, and normalized weekly meeting blocks.

nodes.title: dosage catalog, PK & intakes
nodes.summary: Read-only medication references and owner-only administration snapshots.

nodes.title: Vercel Deployment
nodes.summary: Hosts the StudyOS PWA over HTTPS for Mac and iPhone access.

edges.summary: Subject access is restricted to the sole authenticated owner.

edges.label: owns
edges.summary: Each Section belongs to exactly one Workstream.

edges.label: owns
edges.summary: Each Task belongs to exactly one Project, either directly or through a matching Workstream.

edges.label: optional Subject
